spans.s:
m. (-रः)
An iguana.
E.
गोधा an alligator, and आरक् affix of descent; considered as the offspring of the alligator, on account of its smaller size, and similar shape; also गौधेय and गाधेर.

m. (-यः)
An iguana.
E.
गोधा, and ढक् affix: see the last.

m. (-रः)
An iguana.
E.
गौधा, and द्रक् affix: see गौधार.
